slides.story_job: Start with the missing bid, not the lesson.
slides.visual_direction: Aachu has something tiny to show, but the words stay inside her. She is half-turned toward Zuv, then quietly turns back. Zuv is nearby, mid-task, not yet aware the room changed.
slides.swipe_reason: The viewer wants to know what happened to the first two bids.

slides.story_job: Reveal the tiny hurt without making either person cruel.
slides.visual_direction: Two soft visual echoes: her showing a small thing; his distracted 'hmm' body language while his eyes stay on a task. Keep him human, not cold.
slides.swipe_reason: The viewer recognizes the everyday miss and feels the stakes.

slides.on_image_text: So she kept it to herself.
slides.story_job: Make the consequence visible: missed bids turn into quiet.
slides.visual_direction: Aachu lowers the phone/object into her lap or turns it away, face soft but smaller. The tiny thing is still visible enough to show what got withheld.
slides.swipe_reason: The story has an emotional cost, so the repair matters.

slides.story_job: Turn the story: love is not perfect attention, it is noticing the shift.
slides.visual_direction: Zuv finally looks up, not at the object but at her quiet. His posture changes; his hand leaves the task. The distance between them becomes the scene.
slides.swipe_reason: The repair begins through action, not apology copy.

slides.story_job: Land repair as the tender thesis: turning back is a love language.
slides.visual_direction: Zuv has fully turned toward her, hand open, face warm and a little sorry. Aachu begins to show the tiny thing again; the object is secondary to the re-opened doorway.
slides.swipe_reason: The line is saveable and sendable because it asks for repair, not perfection.
